$comment: Data contract for the weekly-analytics client-health digest. render.py FREEZES the format; only this DATA varies per run. runs/ is append-only. Deterministic: render bakes NO timestamp/random — week_label + all dates come from the DATA. collect.py emits this shape.
title: string (report title)
alert: string|absent — OPTIONAL top-level red banner. Set by the collector's global precalc-gap guard when the report-week volume is far below the trailing average (likely a pipeline gap); when present, all red flags are suppressed. Omit in the normal case.
week_label: string — human week window, e.g. 'Sep 8 – Sep 14, 2026' (the DATA carries it; render never computes it)

summary.clients_flagged: int — tenants with >=1 red flag (incl. dropped-to-zero)
summary.clients_no_data: int — active campaign but no analytics activity yet
summary.clients_dormant: int — active accounts with no running campaign (not sending)

clients.name: string — company_name (tenant display)
clients.parent_user_id: int — users.id of the tenant owner (stable id, used for anchors + diff keying)
clients.status: active | dropped_to_zero | new | no_data | dormant | error
clients.has_active_campaign: bool — the tenant has >=1 automation_campaign with is_active=true
clients.note: string|null — free text for no_data / dormant / new / error rows

flags.metric: string — human metric name, e.g. 'Replies received'
flags.direction: down | up — the UNHEALTHY direction that tripped
flags.pct: string — signed pct move, e.g. '-62%' or 'to zero'

metrics.label: string — display label
metrics.email: number|null — email split (omit/null if not split)
metrics.baseline: number|null — prior-4-week trailing average (null when new/no-baseline)
metrics.delta_pct: string|null — signed pct vs baseline, e.g. '+12%' (null when no baseline)
metrics.flagged: bool — this metric tripped a red flag

completeness.days_present: int — snapshot days found for the week (expect 7)
completeness.warning: string|null — e.g. '2 days missing — flags suppressed' (set when days_present<expected)

campaigns.id: int|null — automation_campaign id (null = unattributed bucket, or the '+N more' fold row)
campaigns.name: string — campaign name (from revhero_prod_campaign)
campaigns.is_active: bool — campaign is_active NOW (may differ from the report week for backfills)

messages_sent: number — weekly totals aligned to weeks[]

method: string — one-paragraph method + source note (read-only snapshots, 4-week trend, floors)
